title: Frequency host events become personal notes from the Owner, waiting in his drafts inbox: stall nudges, thank-yous with a share kit, referral asks, Founding Year and limit notes, and same-day opt-outs
description: On 2026-11-11 the Owner asked for the launch machine (plan v2, loops 3, 4.1, 5 and 6). A new flow, host-moments (flows/host-moments: stream.json template email, trigger event, tier L1, shipped off like the other flows), reads Frequency host events from $FW_HOME/flows/host-moments/events/*.json, one event per file in the shapes of the Frequency integration contract v1, and moves each one to events/done/ once handled (packages/daemon/src/flows/host-moments.ts). Each moment becomes one draft in the flow's Supervisor drafts folder, waiting for the Owner: launcher.stalled names the step and offers a 10 minute setup call, at most one per host per step; space.published is a thank-you naming the payload detail, due within 48 hours (shown on the draft), with a host share kit (Instagram caption, story text, a WhatsApp or email blurb and a QR poster link to the RSVP page) when an event.published for that host is known; event.filled is a referral ask with a forwardable intro the host sends (FlowWeb never contacts the people referred); event.rsvps_8 is a Founding Year note using only payload numbers and the facts sheet $FW_HOME/facts.json, skipped with a reason when the facts are missing; meter.80 is a short what changes note from facts only. host.opted_out puts the host on the existing do-not-contact list the same day, and no later draft is written for them. A draft greets the host by first_name when the event has one, else Hi there; it links back to the original draft through ref; it holds no em or en dash. fwd scans every 5 minutes (FW_HOST_MOMENTS_EVERY_MS); opt-outs are honoured even while the flow is off, drafts are written only while the Owner has it on.
acceptance: Six host event files in a fresh FW_HOME give one draft each of the right kind, none with an em or en dash, and every file moves to events/done
The thank-you carries a share kit pointing at the event's RSVP page when an event.published for that host exists
event.rsvps_8 with no facts sheet makes no Founding Year draft and says why
host.opted_out puts the host on the do-not-contact list the same day, and later events for that host make no draft
A second stall at the same step makes no second draft
